paragraphs: In [Rosh Hashanah 22a](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_Hashanah.22a.1): he was the head of Gader; he detained the witnesses, and Rabban Gamliel removed him from his high position.[^1]

notes.text: Rabbi Yehudah disputes the Mishnah’s attribution to Rabbi Akiva. He names Shezaphar (שזפר), rendered Zefer in the linked English, and says Rabban Gamliel sent to have him removed from office.
